ucs.title: [LLM] LockBit (BITWISE SPIDER) pre-encryption recovery-inhibitor chain on one host within 10m
ucs.description: Hunts the textbook LockBit 2.0/3.0/Black/Green/5.0 staging sequence — vssadmin shadow-copy purge + wmic shadowcopy delete + bcdedit recovery disable + wbadmin backup catalog wipe + wevtutil log clear — fired in tight succession on the same host. Documented in CISA #StopRansomware advisories AA23-075A and AA23-165A as a LockBit affiliate signature regardless of LockBit version.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count, values(Processes.process) as cmd_lines, values(Processes.process_name) as inhibitors, min(_time) as first_seen, max(_time) as last_seen from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where ((Processes.process_name=vssadmin.exe AND Processes.process="*delete*shadows*") OR (Processes.process_name=wmic.exe AND Processes.process="*shadowcopy*delete*") OR (Processes.process_name=bcdedit.exe AND (Processes.process="*bootstatuspolicy*ignoreallfailures*" OR Processes.process="*recoveryenabled*No*")) OR (Processes.process_name=wbadmin.exe AND Processes.process="*delete*" AND (Processes.process="*catalog*" OR Processes.process="*backup*" OR Processes.process="*systemstatebackup*")) OR (Processes.process_name=wevtutil.exe AND Processes.process="*cl *")) by Processes.dest, Processes.user, _time span=10m
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| eval inhib_count = mvcount(inhibitors)
| where inhib_count >= 2 AND NOT match(user, "(?i)\$$")
| sort - last_seen
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where AccountName !endswith "$" and AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| where (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("delete","shadows"))
    or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete")
    or (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and (ProcessCommandLine has "bootstatuspolicy" or ProcessCommandLine has "recoveryenabled"))
    or (FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("catalog","backup","systemstatebackup"))
    or (FileName =~ "wevtutil.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "cl ")
| summarize InhibitorCount = dcount(FileName),
            Inhibitors = make_set(FileName),
            SampleCmds = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 10),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
            ParentProcs = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 5)
            by DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, 10m)
| where InhibitorCount >= 2    // 2+ distinct inhibitor binaries in a 10m window — LockBit signature density
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where (NewProcessName endswith "\\vssadmin.exe" and CommandLine has_all ("delete","shadows"))
    or (NewProcessName endswith "\\wmic.exe" and CommandLine has "shadowcopy" and CommandLine has "delete")
    or (NewProcessName endswith "\\bcdedit.exe" and (CommandLine has "bootstatuspolicy" or CommandLine has "recoveryenabled"))
    or (NewProcessName endswith "\\wbadmin.exe" and CommandLine has "delete" and CommandLine has_any ("catalog","backup","systemstatebackup"))
    or (NewProcessName endswith "\\wevtutil.exe" and CommandLine has "cl ")
| summarize InhibitorCount = dcount(NewProcessName),
            Inhibitors = make_set(NewProcessName),
            SampleCmds = make_set(CommandLine, 10),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
            ParentProcs = make_set(ParentProcessName, 5)
            by Computer, SubjectUserName, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where InhibitorCount >= 2
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: LockBit Ransomware Recovery-Inhibitor Chain
id: 7c8e3d2f-4b6a-4f5d-9b1e-2a7c8d9f1e6b
status: experimental
description: Detects the LockBit (BITWISE SPIDER / Storm-0506 affiliates) signature combination of shadow-copy purge, BCDEdit recovery disable, wbadmin catalog wipe, and wevtutil log clear used to prep a host for encryption. CISA AA23-075A / AA23-165A.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-165a
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-075a
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/18
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.t1489
  - attack.t1070.004
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  vssadmin:
    Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'delete'
      - 'shadows'
  wmic_shadow:
    Image|endswith: '\wmic.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'shadowcopy'
      - 'delete'
  bcdedit:
    Image|endswith: '\bcdedit.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'bootstatuspolicy'
      - 'recoveryenabled'
  wbadmin:
    Image|endswith: '\wbadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'delete'
      - 'catalog'
  wevtutil:
    Image|endswith: '\wevtutil.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: 'cl '
  condition: vssadmin or wmic_shadow or bcdedit or wbadmin or wevtutil
falsepositives:
  - Authorised disaster-recovery rehearsal or backup-server maintenance scripts
  - SCCM / Intune cleanup tasks (filter on initiating service account)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 -@User:*$ ( (@Image:(*\\vssadmin.exe OR *\\VSSAdmin.exe OR *\\VSSADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*"delete shadows"* OR *"Delete Shadows"* OR *"DELETE SHADOWS"*)) OR (@Image:(*\\wmic.exe OR *\\WMIC.exe OR *\\WMIC.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*shadowcopy*delete* OR *SHADOWCOPY*DELETE*)) OR (@Image:(*\\bcdedit.exe OR *\\BCDEdit.exe OR *\\BCDEDIT.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*bootstatuspolicy* OR *recoveryenabled* OR *RecoveryEnabled* OR *BOOTSTATUSPOLICY*)) OR (@Image:(*\\wbadmin.exe OR *\\WBAdmin.exe OR *\\WBADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*"delete catalog"* OR *"delete backup"* OR *"delete systemstatebackup"*)) OR (@Image:(*\\wevtutil.exe OR *\\WevtUtil.exe OR *\\WEVTUTIL.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*"cl "* OR *"clear-log"*)) )
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ((ImageFileName=/\\vssadmin\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/delete\s+shadows/i)
    OR (ImageFileName=/\\wmic\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/shadowcopy\s+delete/i)
    OR (ImageFileName=/\\bcdedit\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/(bootstatuspolicy\s+ignoreallfailures|recoveryenabled\s+no)/i)
    OR (ImageFileName=/\\wbadmin\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/delete\s+(catalog|backup|systemstatebackup)/i)
    OR (ImageFileName=/\\wevtutil\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/\bcl\b/i))
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName], function=[count(as=event_count), collect([ImageFileName, CommandLine]), min(@timestamp, as=first_seen), max(@timestamp, as=last_seen)])
| inhib_count := length("ImageFileName")
| inhib_count >= 2
| sort(last_seen, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: Random APTs don't string together bcdedit-bootstatuspolicy + wbadmin-delete-catalog + wmic-shadowcopy-delete in one window — these five live-off-the-land binaries collapsed inside ~10 minutes on a single host is documented in CISA AA23-165A as the pre-encryption fingerprint used by every LockBit affiliate from 2.0 through 5.0, regardless of which loader or initial-access broker delivered them. ucs.title: [LLM] LockBit Black / 3.0 / 5.0 loader -pass <32-hex> decryption argument
ucs.description: LockBit 3.0 (Black), Green, and 5.0 builders ship a passworded payload that refuses to execute without `-pass <32-character hex key>` (also seen with `-k`, `-id`, `-pass <KEY>`). This unique self-protection — designed to defeat sandbox detonation and IR replay — is documented in CISA AA23-075A and Microsoft's Storm-0506 / DEV-0193 reporting and is unique to LockBit-family binaries; legitimate Windows tooling does not take a 32-hex `-pass` argument.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count, values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents, values(Processes.process_path) as proc_path, values(Processes.process_hash) as hashes, min(_time) as first_seen, max(_time) as last_seen from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process="*-pass*" OR Processes.process="*-k *" by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name, Processes.process
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| rex field=process "(?i)\s\-(pass|k|pwd)\s+(?<pass_val>[A-Fa-f0-9]{32})(?:\b|$)"
| where isnotnull(pass_val)
| search NOT process_name IN (msiexec.exe, msbuild.exe, msdeploy.exe, sqlcmd.exe, openssl.exe, 7z.exe, 7za.exe, winrar.exe, rar.exe)
| eval is_temp = if(match(proc_path, "(?i)\\\\(Users\\\\Public|Temp|Windows\\\\Temp|ProgramData|AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp|PerfLogs)\\\\"), 1, 0)
| sort - last_seen
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\s-(pass|k|pwd)\s+[A-Fa-f0-9]{32}(\b|$)"
| where FileName !in~ ("msiexec.exe","msbuild.exe","msdeploy.exe","sqlcmd.exe","openssl.exe","7z.exe","7za.exe","winrar.exe","rar.exe")
| extend SuspiciousPath = FolderPath matches regex @"(?i)\\(Users\\Public|Temp|Windows\\Temp|ProgramData|AppData\\Local\\Temp|PerfLogs|\$Recycle\.Bin)\\"
| extend KeyArg = extract(@"(?i)\s-(?:pass|k|pwd)\s+([A-Fa-f0-9]{32})", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          FileName, FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine, KeyArg, SuspiciousPath,
          SHA256, MD5,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          IsRemoteSession = InitiatingProcessAccountName
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)

ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: LockBit Black/3.0/5.0 -pass 32-Hex Decryption Argument
id: 4b1a7f5c-2d9e-4d7e-a1c8-3b5e9c6f7b2a
status: experimental
description: LockBit 3.0 (Black), Green, and 5.0 require a -pass / -k argument carrying a 32-character hex key to decrypt the payload before execution. This anti-sandbox feature is unique to LockBit-family binaries (CISA AA23-075A; Microsoft Storm-0506 reporting).
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-075a
  - https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/security/operations/incident-response-playbooks
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/18
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1486
  - attack.t1027.002
  - attack.t1140
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    CommandLine|re: '(?i)\s-(pass|k|pwd)\s+[A-Fa-f0-9]{32}(\b|$)'
  filter_known_legit:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\msiexec.exe'
      - '\msbuild.exe'
      - '\msdeploy.exe'
      - '\sqlcmd.exe'
      - '\openssl.exe'
      - '\7z.exe'
      - '\7za.exe'
      - '\winrar.exe'
      - '\rar.exe'
  condition: selection and not filter_known_legit
falsepositives:
  - Custom in-house tooling that takes a 32-char hex key on a -pass flag (verify and add Image filter)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @CommandLine:(*" -pass "* OR *" -k "* OR *" -pwd "* OR *" -PASS "*) -@Image:(*\\msiexec.exe OR *\\MsiExec.exe OR *\\MSIEXEC.EXE OR *\\msbuild.exe OR *\\MSBuild.exe OR *\\MSBUILD.EXE OR *\\msdeploy.exe OR *\\MSDeploy.exe OR *\\sqlcmd.exe OR *\\SQLCMD.EXE OR *\\openssl.exe OR *\\OpenSSL.exe OR *\\7z.exe OR *\\7Z.EXE OR *\\7za.exe OR *\\winrar.exe OR *\\WinRAR.exe OR *\\WINRAR.EXE OR *\\rar.exe OR *\\Rar.exe OR *\\RAR.EXE) @Image:(*\\Users\\Public\\* OR *\\Temp\\* OR *\\ProgramData\\* OR *\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\* OR *\\PerfLogs\\* OR *\\$Recycle.Bin\\*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| regex("(?i)\\s-(pass|k|pwd)\\s+[A-Fa-f0-9]{32}(\\b|$)", field=CommandLine)
| NOT ImageFileName=/\\(msiexec|msbuild|msdeploy|sqlcmd|openssl|7z|7za|winrar|rar)\.exe$/i
| pass_key := regex("(?i)\\s-(?:pass|k|pwd)\\s+(?P<pass_key>[A-Fa-f0-9]{32})", field=CommandLine, strict=false)
| suspicious_path := if(regex("(?i)\\\\(Users\\\\Public|Temp|ProgramData|AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp|PerfLogs|\\$Recycle\\.Bin)\\\\", field=ImageFileName), then="yes", else="no")

| sort(last_seen, order=desc)
